p: West Blackhall Street is one of Greenock's main shopping streets, a short walk from the waterfront, and the town's history as a great shipbuilding and sugar port is never far away.

Down on the Esplanade there are big views across the Firth of Clyde to the hills, and cruise ships call in at the Greenock Ocean Terminal in season. James Watt, the steam engine pioneer, was born in Greenock, and the town still celebrates the connection. Admiral is an over-18s gaming centre, so the kids won't be going in. If you're out for the day, Gourock and its seafront are just along the coast.
